answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in completion and QA tasks using metrics such as AUROC, perplexity, Self-BLEU, and distinct n-grams.

answer_2.quote: Our detectability evaluation relies on AUROC, FPR at a fixed FNR of 0.01, and FNR at a fixed FPR of 0.01. We assess generation quality using perplexity, derived from a larger model. To measure generation diversity, our approach includes Self-BLEU and Distinct 1-gram and 2-gram.
